## v0.2.0 - The Big Visual + Balance Overhaul

**TLDR:** Dungeons got a massive visual glow-up with 3/4 perspective walls, perspective doors, overhauled chests, cinematic intro sequence, and floating combat text polish. Three underperforming classes (Hexblade, Plague Doctor, Shaman) received targeted balance passes. New weapon proficiency system lets each class equip only thematically appropriate weapons. Audio workbench gained a full DSP suite with FM synthesis, reverb, chorus, and a sound editor UI. Performance optimizations cut dungeon rendering cost dramatically.

**Visuals**
- Faux 3/4 perspective walls - dungeons now have depth like Enter the Gungeon
- Orientation-aware doors render differently based on passage direction
- Treasure chests overhauled with barrel-domed lids, wood planks, tier-specific locks, and interior sparkles
- Floating combat text with ease-out motion, pop-in scale, critical hit glow, and heal bob
- Cinematic intro sequence with Rune Gate Studio splash and HERO'S CALL title reveal
- Torch-light FoV with progressive distance falloff
- Wall-mounted props now actually render on wall tiles instead of floors
- Wall side-plate perspective for left/right facing walls
- Animated water caustics, ambient theme particles, unit light interaction, and screen vignette

**Balance**
- Shaman: New Spirit Link skill (50/50 damage share with ally) replaces Soul Anchor, kiting distance 1 to 2
- Plague Doctor: Ranged damage +17%, Miasma +50%, Plague Flask +25%, Enfeeble now shreds -2 armor
- Hexblade: New Wither lifesteal (50% heal per tick), new Hex Strike skill with Wither synergy bonus

**Systems**
- Weapon type proficiency - each class has curated allowed weapon types
- Smart loot bias - 60% chance weapon drops match party preferences
- Hiring Hall rework - role tags, skill previews, random starting gear, gear-based hire cost
- Multi-effect debuff handler - skills can now bundle multiple debuff effects
- Unified oscillation handler replaces 4 independent anti-oscillation systems
- PVPVE chest scarcity rebalance - fewer but better chests

**Audio Workbench**
- 7 new DSP primitives: FM synthesis, bitcrusher, ring mod, delay, formant filter, tremolo, pitch envelope
- Schroeder reverb, chorus, and stereo imaging on all 123 generated sounds
- Sound editor UI with per-parameter sliders, presets, and live preview
- 11 bespoke sound generators upgraded with new DSP

**Performance**
- Dungeon ambient redraws throttled from 60fps to 12fps
- Wall and door perspective caching after first render
- Hero light map cached between turns
- measureText cache, vignette gradient caching, zero-allocation position interpolator
- FPS overlay in DevOverlay with sparkline graph

**Exploration AI**
- Party breadcrumb trail - followers form a column behind the leader
- Corridor-aware anti-backtrack prevents followers freezing behind walls
- Smart pathfind failure counting - temporary blockages no longer permanently skip rooms
- Leader succession properly clears follow stance on promoted followers
- Escalating room skip durations prevent infinite retry loops

**Dungeon Props**
- Props validated against walkable tiles - no more invisible wall-tile spawns
- Slot priority system - enemies guard entrances, loot hides in back corners
- Chest clustering creates treasure nooks along closed walls
- Tight floor bounds replace fixed 1-tile inset for irregular rooms
